📰 General

Texas Investigates Lululemon Over Potential PFAS Exposure in Athletic Wear •

Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton initiated an investigation into Lululemon following concerns regarding the presence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) in the company’s athletic apparel. The investigation centers on whether Lululemon’s products contain these “forever chemicals,” which are known to be linked to cancer. Paxton’s office is requesting records to determine if the chemicals are present and to what extent. This action follows growing public concern about the prevalence of PFAS in everyday consumer goods.

🌍 World

Inquiry Reveals Parents’ Failures Contributed to Deadly Dance Class Attack •

A recent UK inquiry concluded that the fatal stabbing of three girls and injuries to ten others at a Taylor Swift-themed dance class in Southport in 2024 could have been avoided. The investigation found that the perpetrator’s parents failed to adequately address his concerning behavior and access to weapons. Furthermore, state agencies also missed opportunities to intervene and assess the risk posed by the teenager. The report highlights significant shortcomings in both familial and governmental responses to the escalating situation.

🦅 US

March Existing-Home Sales Decline 3.6% – NAR Reports Significant Drop •

The National Association of REALTORS® (NAR) reported a 3.6% decrease in existing-home sales for March 2026. This represents a month-over-month decline in sales activity within the U.S. housing market. The report indicates a continued shift in market dynamics, with sales falling below levels seen in previous months. Inventory levels remained relatively low, contributing to the downward trend observed in March.

💰 Business

Texas Investigates Lululemon Over Potential PFAS Contamination in Activewear •

The Texas Attorney General’s office has initiated an investigation into Lululemon regarding the possible presence of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, commonly known as “forever chemicals,” in the company’s activewear products. Ken Paxton’s probe will assess whether Lululemon’s manufacturing processes utilized these chemicals, which are known to persist in the environment and human bodies. The investigation stems from concerns about the potential health and environmental impacts associated with these persistent chemicals. Paxton’s office intends to examine Lululemon’s supply chain and manufacturing practices as part of the inquiry.

💻 Technology

American Airlines and Major US Carriers Now Support Apple Wallet Boarding Passes •

Apple has expanded support for its revamped boarding pass feature within Apple Wallet, now including all four of the largest airlines in the United States. United Airlines and Southwest Airlines previously launched the feature, and today, American Airlines has also integrated the functionality. Passengers utilizing iOS 26 can now store and present their boarding passes directly through the Wallet app, eliminating the need for paper tickets. This update streamlines the airport experience and offers a convenient digital alternative for travelers.

🎭 Entertainment

Justin Bieber Revived Coachella with YouTube Nostalgia and a Stripped-Down Setlist •

Justin Bieber’s Coachella performance leaned heavily on his early career, mirroring his initial rise to fame through YouTube videos. The set featured a minimalist stage design and relied primarily on clips from his past performances, reminiscent of his 2000s beginnings. Producer Scooter Braun played a key role in discovering Bieber’s talent through these online videos, influencing the concert’s aesthetic and focus. The performance generated significant online buzz, with fans and critics alike referencing Bieber’s YouTube origins and the concert’s nostalgic appeal.

🏅 Sports

Former NFL Cornerback Chris Payton-Jones Dies in Florida Car Accident at 30 •

Chris Payton-Jones, a former NFL cornerback, died on Saturday following a car accident in Gainesville, Florida. The 30-year-old was driving a sedan when it collided head-on with a pickup truck on State Road 24. Authorities are investigating the circumstances surrounding the accident, which occurred in the eastbound lanes of the westbound road. Payton-Jones’s death was confirmed by The Guardian, who reported widespread grief from those who knew him.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Bizarre Spiral Hydrogen Flows Deep Within Uranus & Neptune •

Researchers have identified distinct spiral patterns of hydrogen within the interiors of Uranus and Neptune. These patterns involve carbon hydride, a substance typically only found under extreme pressures and temperatures. The observed behavior challenges current models of planetary interiors and suggests a more complex state of matter exists within these gas giants. Scientists believe this discovery could revolutionize our understanding of planetary formation and evolution. Further research is planned to investigate the precise mechanisms driving these unusual flows.

🩺 Health

Despite Advances, Heart Disease Remains Top Killer – Here’s Why. •

Cardiovascular disease continues to be the leading cause of death in the United States, despite significant medical advancements over the past century. Researchers attribute this persistent issue to a combination of factors, including lifestyle choices like diet and exercise, and genetic predispositions. The article highlights the impact of chronic inflammation on the arteries, contributing to plaque buildup and increasing the risk of heart attacks and strokes. Furthermore, disparities in access to healthcare and preventative measures exacerbate the problem within certain populations.
